name: Middle pool · stone steps up to Calle Eva
trust: Three rough stone steps with white-painted sides on the north-west half of Calle Eva where it leaves the middle pool courtyard, beside a steep terracotta-tiled ramp, between the end wall of the raised planter and a tall hedge (IMG_2333, looking south-west from the courtyard). Treads about 0.45 m (one stone slab each); together the steps climb the same 0.5 m as the ramp, which reaches the top tread's level about 2.5 m up. The foot is placed 2.6 m along the lane from the courtyard junction, beside the planter's south end wall, from the IMG_2333 pin (+-3 m) and the planter outline: position about +-1 m.
